proposition: None of the eight later papers read (Prologue, Occult Court, New Brethren, Sensorium, Grammatology, Second Aristotle, Timurid-Mughal, Selenocentrism) gives a year for the first or second inquisition or lists the three by date. The only later date attached to persecution is 1427, for Qāsim-i Anvār's exile with Ibn Turka in the Occult Court; the Timurid-Mughal chapter refers to the persecution of lettrists like Ibn Turka on the pretext of Hurufi association without a date. This is a statement about the pages read and about searches of the other pages, not about the whole of each paper.
